newsitem.title: USA: Questron Tech. says completes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Questron Tech. says completes acquisition.

text.p: Questron Technology Inc said Monday it had completed the acquisition of Integrated Material Systems Inc, a Scottsdale, Arizona-based master distributor of fasteners, for $2.25 million.

The purchase price consisted of shares of Questron common stock issued in exchange for all the outstanding shares of Integrated Material and future consideration conditioned upon profit performance, the company said.
Questron said that founder James Taylor had entered into a five year employment agreement to continue as president of Integrated Material.
